== English errata comparison sources ==
The November 1998 Glossary broadens the piloting bonus, specifies piloting Slave I and makes the additional battle destiny optional. The January 2002 Supplement repeats that wording. Its following prison-transfer entry is a ruling.

Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=28 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF pages 28–29. Decipher, updated 29 January 2002, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/ff/Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf#page=2 Glossary Supplement], PDF page 2. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=2 Decipher Errata], PDF page 2. Players Committee, Appendix A, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=105 2023 Advanced Rulebook], PDF page 105.
